AppError.title: Something went wrong
AppError.description: An unexpected error occurred. Check your connection and try again.
AppError.contactPrefix: If this keeps happening, contact us at

AccountFingerprint.title: Account fingerprint
AccountFingerprint.description: Compare this fingerprint with Android and the bridge to confirm they are connected to the same encrypted account. It is not a recovery secret. People you share with should compare this fingerprint with you over a separate channel, such as in person or on a call.
AccountFingerprint.unavailable: Fingerprint unavailable. Make sure sync has finished initializing, then try again.

RestoreDiagnostics.title: Restore diagnostics
RestoreDiagnostics.description: Copy a privacy-safe restore report when support asks for sync diagnostics. This action appears only when restore diagnostics are available in debug-enabled preview or local sessions.

Notes.title: Notes
Notes.offlineMessage: You are offline. Edits to an open note are saved encrypted on this device and sync when you reconnect, unless the note changed elsewhere or the editor shows Not saved. New notes and moves need a connection, so New note and the notebook picker are turned off.
Notes.emptyDescription: Write privately in Markdown. Add a note to get started.
Notes.noVisibleNotesDescription: Show a notebook to see its notes here.
Notes.selectNote: Select a note to edit, or create a new one.
Notes.deleteConfirmMessage: "{title}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
Notes.noSearchResultsDescription: Search looks at titles and text of the notes shown here, on this device only.
Notes.closingSave: Saving your last changes to this note…
Notes.reopeningHeldText: Checking this browser for text that was not saved…
Notes.conflictChanged: This note changed somewhere else after you started editing, so your text was not saved over it. Your text is still here.
Notes.conflictUnproved: This browser could not confirm that the note is unchanged since you started editing, so your text was not saved over it. Your text is still here.
Notes.newerVersionSame: The server still has the version you started from.
Notes.newerVersionDeleted: This note was deleted somewhere else. Save your text as a copy to keep it.
Notes.newerVersionOffline: The newer version cannot be loaded while you are offline.
Notes.newerVersionUnreadable: The newer version could not be read in this browser.
Notes.newerVersionUnknown: The newer version could not be loaded from the server.
Notes.copyFailedOffline: Not copied: you are offline, and a copy needs a connection.
Notes.copyFailedUnconfirmed: Not copied: the server did not confirm the copy. Saving as a copy again will not make a second one.
Notes.copyFailedDeleted: Not copied: the copy was deleted somewhere else before this browser could confirm it. Saving as a copy again makes a new one.
Notes.copyFailedChanged: Not copied: the copy was changed somewhere else before this browser could confirm it. Saving as a copy again makes a new one.
Notes.copyFailedReadOnly: Not copied: you cannot add notes to this notebook.
Notes.copyFailedNoNotebook: Not copied: this note's notebook is not available in this browser.
Notes.newNoteOffline: New note is turned off while you are offline. A new note needs a connection.
Notes.moveOffline: Moving a note is turned off while you are offline. A move needs a connection.
Notes.emptyOfflineDescription: New notes need a connection, so New note is turned off while you are offline.
Notes.createQueueRefused: No note was created. The server could not be reached, and a new note needs a connection.
Notes.createFailed: No note was created because saving it to your account failed.
Notes.createUnavailable: No note was created. Your account or this notebook is not loaded on this page. Reloading the page loads them again.
Notes.createQueued: The note is not in your list yet. It is saved on this device and is added to your account when you reconnect, without a name.
Notes.createNoSession: No note was created. Your account is not unlocked on this page yet. If an Unlock now button is shown at the top, use it. Otherwise reload the page.
Notes.noNotesInNotebookDescription: New notes go here while this notebook is selected.
Notes.deleteNotebookMessage: {count, plural, =0 {"{name}" is empty and will be permanently deleted.} one {"{name}" and the # note in it will be permanently deleted.} other {"{name}" and the # notes in it will be permanently deleted.}} This cannot be undone.
Notes.deleteNotebookUnsaved: Notebook not deleted: a note in it has changes that are not on the server yet, such as a note marked Not saved. Nothing was deleted.
Notes.deleteNotebookChanged: Notebook not deleted: this browser could not confirm that it shows everything in it. Nothing was deleted.
Notes.disabledDescription: Enable Notes in Settings to use encrypted Markdown notes. Any existing notes are preserved while this feature is off.

SettingsExport.exportNotes: Export Notes ({count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}})
SettingsExport.notesFormat: Saved as a .zip with one folder per notebook and one Markdown (.md) file per note.
SettingsExport.notesWaitingToSync: Notes are exported as the server has them, so a note change still waiting to sync on this device isn't included.
SettingsExport.notesLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# note couldn't be read on this device and was left out of the export.} other {# notes couldn't be read on this device and were left out of the export.}}
SettingsExport.notesNeedConnection: Exporting notes needs a connection, so nothing was exported. Connect, then export again.
SettingsExport.notesExportFailed: Notes export failed. Please try again.
SettingsExport.allDataWithNotes: Includes every calendar, task list, address book, and notebook in a single archive.

Language.title: Language
Language.description: Most of the app is still in English. Italian covers only some screens for now. This choice applies to this browser only and is not synced to your account or other devices.

SettingsReport.title: Report a problem
SettingsReport.intro: Tell us about a problem or suggest a feature. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
SettingsReport.emailHint: Only if you want an answer.
SettingsReport.previewLabel: Diagnostic info that will be sent
SettingsReport.previewHint: This is exactly what will be sent with your report. It contains no account details, server addresses or content.
SettingsReport.disclosure: Your report is sent through Cloudflare and delivered by email (via Resend) to the SilentSuite support inbox. It is not end-to-end encrypted and not linked to your account. We keep it for as long as we need it to deal with your report; to have it deleted, email {email}.
SettingsReport.unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm your report was sent. You can email it or copy it instead.

errors.controlChars: This contains characters that can't be sent.
errors.email: Enter a valid email address or leave this empty.

SignOut.unsyncedTitle: Log out with changes on this device?
SignOut.unsyncedCount: {count, plural, one {# change is only on this device. Logging out deletes it.} other {# changes are only on this device. Logging out deletes them.}}
SignOut.unsyncedUnknown: This browser could not check for changes that are only on this device. Logging out deletes any it has.
SignOut.confirmCount: {count, plural, one {# change that is only on this device will be deleted when you log out. It cannot be recovered.} other {# changes that are only on this device will be deleted when you log out. They cannot be recovered.}}
SignOut.confirmUnknown: Any changes that are only on this device will be deleted when you log out. They cannot be recovered.
